A '''refuse recycling unit''' was manufactured by [[Wastestream Systems]]. The unit could recycle up to twenty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of refuse and convert it into a useful cellular pulp. The [[MN-2E general maintenance droid]] featured an internal refuse recycling unit accessed by a portal on the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] base.<ref name="EGTD" />
